verdict.rationale: Luma's Modify Video V2 reshapes existing footage and is marketed for swapping specific elements (wall, world, wardrobe) while lighting and performance are preserved, up to 20s at 1080p. Its docs show control comes only from global adherence modes (Adhere/Flex/Reimagine), with no masking, region selection, or documented guarantee that untouched areas stay intact. Missing for 10: element-level masking or region targeting, a documented guarantee that the rest of the frame is preserved, and independent hands-on corroboration of element-only edits.

support.subject: As a creator, I can replace or restyle an element inside an existing video while the rest of the frame stays intact

citations.quote: Modify Video V2 reshapes footage you already have. Swap the wall, the world, the wardrobe. The lighting holds. The performance survives. Up to 20 seconds, all at 1080p.

Adhere - The output adheres very closely to the source video. This is ideal for subtle enhancements, minor retexturing, or applying a light stylistic filter without drastically altering the original content.
Transform people into entirely new characters while preserving performance.
